records.trigger: Missing PRE_CERT inventory recovery is routed to certification_window_status instead of finalization
records.observedFailure: Before the fix, a no-window heavy-certification choke emitted Next: proof-or-stop certification_window_status --storyId=B-0b50-red even though no PRE_CERT inventory receipt existed; this forces an unnecessary intermediate status retry instead of direct TEST-safe finalization.
records.note: The probe is a real pre-fix assertion against the current compiled implementation; it fails on the incorrect status command and will pass after the blocker-specific next command is preserved.
